subject: HSM integration evidence, BYOK options and rotation procedure — HealthPrime RFP
summary: Thread covers HealthPrime's requested evidence for HSM integration and BYOK, clarifies key exportability, rotation cadence, TLS endpoints, and next steps for providing attestation and logs. Mina coordinates internal owners and shares architecture + runbook artifacts.
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@healthprime.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@healthprime.com
Date: 2027-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: HealthPrime RFP - Crypto controls & HSM evidence request

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the responsiveness on the RFP. Attached is the HealthPrime questionnaire where we capture KMS/BYOK and HSM integration requirements (healthprime_rfp_questionnaire.xlsx). A few high-priority clarifications we need before legal/infosec sign-off: 

- Can Redwood support HSM-backed key material with customer-controlled root keys (BYOK) and ensure that private key material is non-exportable from the HSM? We need the exact language we can include in our procurement docs.
- Please provide your HSM vendor & FIPS compliance documentation, plus any attestation you can share.
- Rotation: we need recommended minimum rotation cadence and an operational runbook for customer-triggered rotate/rollover.
- TLS termination: confirm if TLS is terminated inside the VPC/private deployment or at the edge; provide certificate lifecycle and mutual-TLS support details.

Can you also provide a redacted example of the audit/log lines that show key-usage (encrypt/decrypt/sign) for compliance review? We can treat those as controlled evidence.

Timeline: procurement needs this by EOD Friday (2027-06-04) to keep the evaluation on schedule. Let me know if that is feasible and who on your side will own the artifacts.

Thanks,
Alex Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager — HealthPrime
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@healthprime.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: HealthPrime RFP - Crypto controls & HSM evidence request

Alex —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers up top, and attached artifacts below: 

1) BYOK + non-exportability: Yes. For Redwood Private deployments we support customer-provisioned root keys injected into an HSM (we integrate with Thales and AWS CloudHSM). When a key is created/imported into the HSM-backed keyslot, the private key material is marked non-exportable — there is no API or administrative operation that will return raw key material back to a customer or to Redwood. Wording you can use in your contract: 
"Redwood will accept customer-provided root keys into HSM keyslots configured as non-exportable. Private key material shall remain non-exportable by design; Redwood will not retain RAW key material outside of the hardware security module."

2) FIPS/attestation: Attached: fips140-2-attestation.pdf (vendor certs) and redwood_hsm_arch_diagram.pdf (high-level). We can provide supplier attestation under NDA or redaction if you need a sanitized copy.

3) Rotation + runbook: Attached byok-runbook-v1.md and rotation-playbook-sample.csv. Our recommended baseline cadence is 12 months for master/root keys and 90 days for workload/EPHEMERAL keys, with emergency rotation procedures for suspected compromise. The runbook covers: pre-rotate impact analysis, canary rollout across model-serving clusters, automated cache invalidation, and rollback steps.

4) TLS termination & mTLS: For Redwood Hosted API TLS is terminated at the edge with public certs; for Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) TLS termination occurs inside your VPC at the customer-controlled load balancer or the private control plane depending on deployment model. We support mutual-TLS for customer-admin endpoints and support certificate pinning for critical routes. Certificate lifecycle is integrated with customer KMS or our managed ACME for convenience; documentation excerpt is in the attached runbook.

5) Audit logs/sample: We can provide redacted key-usage logs showing envelope-encrypt operations and HSM audit event ids. See rotation-playbook-sample.csv for a small sample and the Drive link for more. Note: raw logs include internal identifiers — we will redact anything that could expose unrelated customer data.

Next steps: 
- We will provide the full sanitized evidence bundle to your security team by EOD Thursday (2027-06-03).
- Marissa Cole (CC'd) will own the attestation packaging and coordinate any NDA or redaction requests.
- Karthik will schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive next week if you want an architecture walkthrough and live demo.

Attachments: redwood_hsm_arch_diagram.pdf (pdf), byok-runbook-v1.md (md), rotation-playbook-sample.csv (csv), fips140-2-attestation.pdf (pdf)

Regards,

Mina Haddad
Head of Security Solutions — Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@healthprime.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@healthprime.com, procure@healthprime.com
Date: 2027-05-31T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: HealthPrime RFP - Crypto controls & HSM evidence request

Thanks Mina — that’s super helpful. A couple follow-ups from SecOps after reviewing the attachments: 

- Confirmed need: the contract language looks good but SecOps would prefer explicit confirmation that HSM audit logs are retained for a minimum of 90 days and are exportable in redacted CSV form on request. Can Redwood support a 90-day retention SLA for exports in Private deployments?
- Attestation: SecOps wants vendor-signed attestation showing FIPS status and our legal team wants to see the chain of custody statement for BYOK imports (who performs the import, what agent can access the HSM during import). Can you state the exact operational roles involved?
- Logs: The sample looks fine; could you include a sample with a mock key-id format that mirrors our logging spec (HP-KID-xxxx)? We will use that to map detection rules.

Procurement also asked whether we can get DocuSign playbook/licensing language to attach to the SOW.

If you can answer the above and send the sanitized artifacts by EOD Thursday, we should be able to keep our evaluation timeline. Also please send a calendar invite for the technical deep-dive; we’ll include our SecOps and platform engineering.

Best,
Alex
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@healthprime.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: RE: HealthPrime RFP - Crypto controls & HSM evidence request

Alex — quick update and package delivery: 

1) Retention SLA: For Redwood Private deployments we support configurable HSM audit-log retention policies; we can contractually guarantee 90-day retention for delivered audit exports. We will add export delivery SLAs to the SOW (example line: "Redwood will retain HSM audit logs for a minimum of 90 days and deliver redacted exports within 3 business days upon request").

2) Chain of custody & import roles: BYOK import is performed by a customer-designated key-operator using a customer-supplied import token. Where Redwood assists with the import (on-prem or by remote ops), the operation is performed under dual-control: Redwood’s Ops Engineer (named-role) and a KMS Engineer (named-role) perform the import together, with the process logged and recorded; private key material remains non-exportable. We have prepared a redacted chain-of-custody statement (attached) describing this process.

3) Log format: Attached is a mock log file (rotation-playbook-sample.csv) showing HP-KID- format entries (example: HP-KID-35A2). We can re-run exports to your exact schema if you provide the mapping.

4) DocuSign & SOW language: I’ve attached a short DocuSign SOW template and a proposed clause for BYOK/HSM handling. If procurement needs a more precise legal wording we can have our contracts team provide a short addendum. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/link/abc12345

Next steps: Marissa will send the sanitized evidence bundle to security@healthprime.com (PDFs and redacted logs). Karthik/Dev will send a calendar invite for a 45-min technical deep-dive next Tuesday (2027-06-08) and include a demo of byok import and rotation workflow in our private sandbox. 

Let us know any additional redaction requirements.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Head of Security Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments included in this message: healthprime_rfp_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx stub), redwood_hsm_arch_diagram.pdf (pdf stub), byok-runbook-v1.md (md stub), rotation-playbook-sample.csv (csv stub), fips140-2-attestation.pdf (pdf stub)
